report:
Reviewed the complete direct_members claim, all five implementation associations and sole TODO test; captured the modules design. Source inspection only; no behavioral tests rerun and no source changes.

The claim requires direct module members rather than a visible-name environment, deterministic order/provenance for source and generated items, child ownership isolation and later import/namespace interpretation. parse_str_to_cst constructs a parser with explicit source and scope and visits the root item list in source order. parse/items.rs parse_mod creates an inline child module and parses its children with ScopeSymbol::Module(child), specifying that child's unexpanded items while returning only the module item to the parent; file-backed membership is likewise deferred to its own module. This avoids flattening child members into parent output.

mods.rs local_expanded_module_items iterates the module's unexpanded item sequence and builds a vector. Ordinary items, including Use and Mod, enter through item publication; imports are not replaced here with all visible names. Bang invocations recursively splice their output at the invocation position. macro_invocations.rs parses that output using the invocation scope and ParseSource::BangMacro, preserving generated provenance. derive.rs parses represented derive output using the source item's scope and ParseSource::Derive. mods.rs appends the original source item before its derive sibling items and iterates derive attributes/names in recorded order. These paths provide the ordered direct-member representation. Macro name lookup during expansion is necessary to determine generated content, but does not turn the returned item vector into a resolved namespace environment.

The sole associated test modules_expand_direct_members is TODO and contains no assertions. It calls for fixtures spanning ordinary/use items, inline modules, recursively generated items and derives with exact direct membership, order, ownership and provenance, explicitly excluding imported/child names from parent membership. Completing and associating that fixture matrix is the prerequisite for full verification; source-level vector order and scope construction are not substitutes for those output assertions. All claim aspects and the five implementations are accounted for, with evidence honestly deferred. No concrete additional defect was identified in the inspected paths and no edits are requested.
